name: 双雷刃ライキリ
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG sprite atlas of the SAME equipment item in four directional views for a small top-down RPG character to hold. Input image is a DESIGN REFERENCE: preserve this item's distinctive silhouette, colors, ornament, materials and identity (双雷刃ライキリ). Exactly 2 by 2 grid, square canvas. Isolated item centered in each equal quadrant with generous clear padding, no overlaps. Reading order top-left FRONT/down, top-right LEFT, bottom-left RIGHT, bottom-right BACK/up. Draw only ONE of the pair's identical blades in EACH cell, not a crossed pair; game duplicates it into two hands. Blade/head always pointing TOP of each cell, handle/pommel at BOTTOM, SAME vertical orientation and scale. Front/down broad face, left-facing narrow oblique view, right-facing narrow oblique view, back/up opposite broad face. Do not rotate the blade horizontally in profile. Preserve original blade, guard and grip. Crisp chunky pixel-art shading, clearly readable reduced to 20 game pixels, simple metal highlights. No character, hands, arms, ground, floor shadow, scene, labels, lettering, grid, border or extra objects. Transparent background.
correctionPrompt: Each quadrant must contain ONE single straight sword blade only. Remove the second blade/fork from the upper-left and lower-right swords; keep one gold-edged purple lightning blade, one guard, one grip in each quadrant.
